column1: # Expected verdicts for block-env-access.sh, one case per line:
#   <want: DENY|allow>  <label>  <the JSON payload the hook receives on stdin>
# Fed with printf '%s', never '%b': an earlier version of this file used %b,
# which turned the \n inside two heredoc payloads into real newlines. That made
# the JSON invalid, so those two cases were answered by the fail-closed
# parse-deny instead of the check under test -- passing for the wrong reason.
# Keep \n as two characters here, and keep `make-sure-it-fails` honest by
# running this matrix against the previous version of the guard.
